code: import{Action}from'@thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk';/** AI-related actions hidden on Starter & Essentials */const AI_ACTIONS=[Action.AIHighlights,Action.SpotIQAnalyze];/** Interactive actions disabled on Starter only */const INTERACTIVE_ACTIONS=[Action.DrillDown,Action.DrillInclude,Action.DrillExclude,Action.Explore,Action.AddFilter,Action.AxisMenuFilter,Action.AxisMenuSort];export function getHiddenActions(tier){switch(tier){case'Starter':case'Essentials':return[...AI_ACTIONS];case'Pro':default:return[];}}export function getDisabledActions(tier){switch(tier){case'Starter':return[...INTERACTIVE_ACTIONS];case'Essentials':case'Pro':default:return[];}}export function isSpotterEnabled(tier){return tier==='Pro';}
